source.title: IrelandElection.com, 2011 Seanad Election: Labour Panel
source.check: The count is IrelandElection.com's; the first preferences add up to the valid poll and the 11 winners fill the seats. Each winner was checked against the Houses of the Oireachtas list of the members of the 24th Seanad for this panel (api.oireachtas.ie, seanad-build, Nov 2026).

franchise: the members of the incoming Dáil, the outgoing Seanad and the city and county councils (Seanad Electoral (Panel Members) Act 1947, s. 44)
sourceNote: Filed under 2011-05-25, the day the Houses of the Oireachtas give as the start of the 24th Seanad; a Seanad general election is held by post, and its polls close over several days.
countSourceNote: Each valid ballot paper is valued at 1,000 so that fractions of a vote can be transferred (Seanad Electoral (Panel Members) Act 1947): 1,066 valid papers make a valid poll of 1,066,000, and every figure is a value, not a number of papers.
electorateNote: 1,092 electors: the members of the incoming Dáil, the outgoing Seanad and the city and county councils (Seanad Electoral (Panel Members) Act 1947, s. 44).
note: The panel has two sub-panels, candidates nominated by members of the Oireachtas and candidates nominated by registered nominating bodies, and a minimum number of seats goes to each.
